title: Chapter 462: Advancing To The Strongest King
content:
Chapter 462: Advancing To The Strongest King

Wang Shuo had thought about asking Naris to take him up directly, but the sky near Youquan Mountain seemed to have an invisible barrier that prohibited flying through.

It seemed that climbing this trail was a test of some kind.

The mountain wind was whistling around, and a small stone slipped down. After a while, the echo was heard from the bottom of the cliff. Wang Shuo had already climbed very high.

But the mountain wind at this time seemed to be getting more serious.

The wind didn't look strong, but it was extremely cold and piercing, penetrating into the bone marrow.

Wang Shuo couldn't help but tremble his teeth.

This was even more uncomfortable than fighting with the king.

Wang Shuo couldn't go up or down now.

He looked up at the mountain, and it was still endless.

Wang Shuo was desperate.

No wonder he saw countless bones at the foot of Youquan Mountain before.

They must be climbers who fell from above!

It's really not easy to become the strongest king!

Wang Shuo now thinks that it's good to break through slowly like the demon king.

The path on Youquan Mountain looks like a shortcut, but it is paved with countless corpses.

Wang Shuo gritted his teeth again and moved up a few steps.

After walking for an unknown period of time, Wang Shuo's consciousness had already fallen into a trance.

He now had only one belief, upward, upward...

The path on the mountain peak could only accommodate one foot.

Wang Shuo's body was close to the mountain, and his hands grasped all the rock protrusions that could be grasped.

Slowly moving forward.

After another day, Wang Shuo finally climbed to the high platform on the top of the mountain without any danger.

During this day, Wang Shuo had countless hallucinations.

Sometimes he felt that he unified the continent and became the supreme ruler, and sometimes he felt that he was killed and betrayed by his subordinates.

Sometimes he felt that he had returned to Blue Star, returned to his warm bed, and wanted to fall asleep.

But he survived all the illusions.

On the high platform, the figure of Lord Zach appeared.

"Congratulations, you passed the test."

Wang Shuo shook his head, forced himself to cheer up, and stood up.

"I almost couldn't stand it."

At this time, the scene around changed.

The top of Youquan Mountain, which was howling with cold wind just now, suddenly became like spring all year round.

Wang Shuo wanted to curse in his heart, it was really a joke, playing with people to death!

There was an ancient palace not far away, and at the door of the palace was a small swimming pool.

"Go!" Lord Zach pointed to the swimming pool.

Wang Shuo just took two steps and suddenly stopped, saying to Lord Zach: "Lord Zach, can my pet take a bath?"

"Haha, you really are... Go!" Lord Zach nodded and said with a smile.

Wang Shuo's face was happy, and he quickly released Da Huang and Bing Fenghuang.

Lord Zach also thoughtfully expanded the swimming pool to accommodate Wang Shuo and his two pets.

Entering the swimming pool, Wang Shuo didn't feel anything, just like taking a hot spring bath, the warm feeling permeated the whole body, the whole body was comfortable, as if all the fatigue was swept away.

After soaking for a while, Wang Shuo felt that he seemed to need to practice.

…

Ten days later.

“Ang.”

A dragon roar was heard, resounding across the mountaintop.

A golden dragon was hovering above the swimming pool, and even Da Huang and Bing Feng Huang, who had been promoted to the strongest king, were a little afraid.

This golden dragon was naturally the ultimate skill “Great Heavenly Dragon” that Wang Shuo had comprehended after practicing “Dragon Spear Art” to the ninth level.
